description: Those bulging, unblinking eyes give off an eerie sense of knowing, as if resigned to fateful gloom from the shadows. But don't be deceived, for Maskfry is always checking if your scent is worthy of the Dagon.

name: Ospisces
skill: Dagon's Tide: Summons waves that inflict Pull and a whirlpool that deals small AoE damage. If multiple enemies are Pulled, the whirlpool inflicts stackable Tidesurge: Weak.
description: Bones of blasphemy now bulge from Ospisces's back, who's developed an aversion to freshwater. At night, wet, guttural murmurs fill the air, as if repeated from an ancient chant. You might find strange, sprawling doodles in the bathtub, along with what looks like a ritual sacrifice of your slippers to a mysterious being.

name: Armorjaw
skill: Dagon's Surge: Summons waves that inflict Pull and a whirlpool that deals small AoE damage. If multiple enemies are Pulled, the whirlpool inflicts Stun and stackable Tidesurge: Weak.
description: There's no turning back now. Armorjaw has outgrown the basin, quietly charting a course toward Devil's Reef. When an attempt to reach out is given, only a cold, distant stare is returned, as if quietly questioning your allegiance to humanity.

name: Dagondeep
skill: Dagon's Abyss: Summons waves that inflict Pull and a whirlpool that deals small AoE damage. If multiple enemies are Pulled, the whirlpool inflicts Stun and stackable Tidesurge: Weak. Dagondeep carries Aura: Water whenever on the battlefield.
description: Dagondeep is the living tide, a presence that haunts dreams with quiet terror. An ancient body encased in layered scales of armor, each movement echoes the tremors of R'lyeh. Now, the webbed hand beckons: Come, master. There is no need to breathe beneath the sea... and the rent is far cheaper.

name: Hootlet
skill: Dawn Call: Creates an AoE terrain in front. Enemies in the terrain take damage and are inflicted with stackable Slowdown.
description: Hootlet believes in time magic and the tail pendulum is a most cherished treasure. Now watch and listen closely... er, was that time magic or sleep magic?

name: Tikowl
skill: Evertide Echo: Creates an AoE terrain in front. Enemies in the terrain take damage and are inflicted with stackable Slowdown. Slowdown can be upgraded to Stun.
description: Tikowl loves answering all kinds of questions, including "Why do humans hunt and return empty-handed?" and "Who should settle Tatari disputes, trainers or Tatari?" Er, beats me anyhow.

name: Chronerva
skill: Midnight Chime: Creates a large terrain AoE in front. Enemies in the terrain take damage and are inflicted with stackable Slowdown. Slowdown can be upgraded to Stun.
description: Chronerva claims to be able to freeze time. Just look at Souverelle who falls still as soon as the chanting starts. Now thats a powerful, intelligent Tatari if you ask me!

name: Hypnostrix
skill: Dies Naturalis: Creates a large AoE terrain in front. Enemies in the terrain take damage and are inflicted with stackable Slowdown. Slowdown can be upgraded to Stun. Hypnostrix carries Aura: Grass whenever on the field.
description: Time is a cycle that nudges the hands of fate. When the pendulum swings back, we'll be reunited with those we've lost.

name: Momopo
skill: Momo's Kiss: Sends a kiss (not bite) to deal AoE damage and deals increased damage to Frail enemies. After killing an enemy, pauses attacks to recover HP.
description: Mud is not dirty. It is the most natural sunscreen around, not that anyone who neglects proper skincare would understand.

name: Lulupo
skill: Lulu's Kiss: Sends a kiss (not bite) to deal AoE damage and deals increased damage to Frail enemies. After killing an enemy, gains a Pink Shield and pauses attacks to recover HP.
description: Don't assume Lulupo is always eating and soaking in the tub. Aerobics are a regular part of the routine for staying in shape. Eat more, move more. Simple as that.

name: Lilypo
skill: Lily's Kiss: Sends a kiss (not bite) to deal AoE damage and deals increased damage to Frail enemies. After killing an enemy, gains a Pink Shield and pauses attacks to recover HP. The Pink Shield deals AoE damage when it disappears.
description: A skirt made of beautiful flower petals is perfect for the most mesmerizing dance. Feeling a little spellbound? Perfectly understandable.

name: Gemmapo
skill: Gemma's Kiss: Sends a kiss (not bite) to deal AoE damage and deals increased damage to Frail enemies. After killing an enemy, gains a Pink Shield and pauses attacks to recover HP. The Pink Shield deals AoE damage when it disappears. Gemmapo carries Aura: Rock whenever on the field.
description: Whether the world turns to ruins or a giant heap of trash, it's still a one-of-a-kind film set for Gemmapo. After all, a bleak backdrop is perfect for making the colors pop. Oh, here comes the breeze. Hold down that skirt, and stay fabulous.

name: Blowfin
skill: Huff and Puff: After taking damage from close-range enemies, counterattacks to deal AoE damage. When not counterattacking, meditates to recover HP.
description: When emotions get out of control, Blowfin turns into a ball. Hates it when Cactobud is up to no good.

name: Puffbelly
skill: Rice at the Ready: After taking damage from close-range enemies, counterattacks to deal AoE damage. When not counterattacking, cooks to recover HP. When counterattacking and cooking, throws sushi to 1 allies, Sushi provides healing and grants Sushi: ATK Boost.
description: This aspiring master chef is ready to put on the signature headband and take a slice at those Zobos. Though, Puffbelly is a bit fixated on cutting everything to the right size.

name: Chefugu
skill: Puffect Artisan: After taking damage from close-range enemies, counterattacks to deal AoE damage. When not counterattacking, cooks to recover HP. When counterattacking and cooking, throws sushi to 2 allies, Sushi provides healing and grants Sushi: ATK Boost.
description: According to humans and Zobos alike, Chefugu smells real good. But careful not to give into temptation -- a single bite could have you writhing on the ground from toxins.

name: Pyromaki
skill: Tachelin Chef: After taking damage from close-range enemies, counterattacks to deal AoE damage. When not counterattacking, cooks to recover HP. When counterattacking and cooking, throws sushi to 1 allies, Sushi provides healing and grants Sushi: ATK Boost. Pyromaki carries Aura: Fire whenever on the field.
description: Ahoy captain! Conquering the deepest seas for the freshest ingredients, Pyromaki has taken the culinary world by storm with the ultimate feast!

name: Glowfly
skill: Glowing Guardian: Grants one front row ally a Static Shield. The shield deals AoE damage when it disappears.
description: A go-to source of ambient lighting for romantic confessions often sought out by humans. Glowfly finds the whole thing unbearably mushy, but sees it through most of the time anyway.

name: Phosflare
skill: Photon Patch: Grants one front row ally a Static Shield. The shield deals AoE damage and inflicts Paralysis when it disappears.
description: A performer who takes every moment seriously. Phosflare refuses to fight without a personal soundtrack and custom lighting. Currently researching how to get vibrant shimmer effects from the color black.

name: Glimmerwing
skill: Glimmer Fixer: Grants one front row ally a Static Shield. The shield deals AoE damage and inflicts Paralysis when it disappears. If unbroken, the shield is transferred to a random ally in an adjacent tile.
description: No trick of the light can deceive Glimmerwing. Appears to have little patience for humans and Tatari who get lost, but offers directions all night anyway.

name: Luminastra
skill: Legion Lumina: Grants one front row ally a Static Shield. The shield deals AoE damage and inflicts Paralysis when it disappears. If unbroken, the shield is transferred to a random ally in an adjacent tile. Luminastra carries Aura: Lightning whenever on the field.

name: Poakie
skill: Sizzle Bubble: Spits flames, dealing AoE damage and inflicting Burn. Sometimes spits flames non-stop, continuously dealing AoE damage.
description: Enjoys drifting in the hot springs at the foot of a volcano. Sometimes gets pushed along by the sizzling bubbles before realizing the surroundings have changed.

name: Sizzribb
skill: Ribbity Drip: Spits flames, dealing AoE damage and inflicting Burn. Sometimes spits flames non-stop, continuously dealing AoE damage. Consumes Burn on targets to deal follow up damage.
description: Loves to press close to the ground, silently sensing distant vibrations as well as changes in temperature and humidity. Whether it's the best resting sot in camp or the newest Zobo hideout, Sizzribb can always tell beforehand, although it'll take some time to actually get moving.

name: Lickflicker
skill: Lick and Whip: Spits flames, dealing large AoE damage and inflicting Burn. Sometimes spits flames non-stop, continuously dealing large AoE damage. Consumes Burn on targets to deal follow up damage.
description: "Lickflickers learn about the world by putting things in their mouths, so keep a close eye on your food, gloves, and valuables-especially anything sensitive to heat."-Tatari Observation Diary

name: Ignitoad
skill: Firesurge Cloud: Spits flames, dealing large AoE damage and inflicting Burn. Sometimes spits flames non-stop, continuously dealing large AoE damage. Consumes Burn on targets to deal follow up damage. Ignitoad carries Aura: Fire whenever on the field.
description: Ignitoad's breath is like a slow, churning current of volcanic heat, scorching the earth beneath. The flames that devour Ignitoad's enemies don't come from rage, however, but rather an attempt to keep the ambient temperature just right.

name: Budboo
skill: Bud Venom: Shoots a seed to deal single-target damage. Sometimes shoots a venomous seed to deal small AoE damage and inflict poison.
description: A mysterious little sprout that prefers to stay hidden in dark, secluded corners. Doesn't know how to say no and often gets dragged out by Buddi for a sunbath.

name: Snapshade
skill: Snap Trap: Shoots a seed to deal single-target damage. Sometimes shoots 3 venomous seed to deal small AoE damage and inflict poison.
description: Snapshade was supposed to be temporary decor when the party ran out of flowers, but ended up sticking around. Oof! Do plants usually try to trip every Tatari passing by?

name: Thornwisp
skill: Thorn Bite: Shoots a seed to deal single-target damage. Sometimes shoots 3 venomous seed to deal small AoE damage and inflict poison. Also creates a poison zone.
description: Thornwisp loves to cast a menacing shadow, taking pleasure in watching Tatari get scared and scatter. But on cold nights, Thornwisp will secretly extend branches to shield sleeping Tatari from the wind.

name: Chomperwraith
skill: Chomp Menace: Shoots a seed to deal single-target damage. Sometimes shoots 3 venomous seed to deal small AoE damage and inflict poison. Also creates a poison zone. Chomperwraith carries Aura: Grass whenever on the field.
description: Chomperwraith's massive flower crown finally sprouted, looking like a movie supervillain. Zobos fear the gaping maw, but fellow Tatari find the shadow it casts to be the safest place of all.
